text:
danielle.reed: Hi all  planning to start parental leave Aug 1. Quick Qs: payroll cutoff for top-up? and do I need to file anything before baby arrives?

sam.hr: Congrats!  For an Aug 1 start submit the Workday leave request by Jul 10 so payroll can process the top-up in time. You can submit earlier. If you don't have paperwork yet, submit a tentative request and attach docs (birth certificate/medical cert) within 30 days after birth.

danielle.reed: Good to know. We do a 10-week primary leave. Are phased returns allowed after that?

ashley.mgr: We support phased returns up to 12 weeks. Manager + People Ops sign-off required. We usually agree on a 1-page plan (days/hours, on-call coverage, deliverables).

danielle.reed: Is the childcare stipend automatic?

sam.hr: Stipend is $500/month for 6 months. You need to opt in via Benefits > Family Support in the portal after you move back to active payroll. No extra approval.

danielle.reed: Any checklist for handover so I don't miss things?

ashley.mgr: Quick checklist: TODOs in repo, test ownership, on-call swaps in #eng-oncall, access notes, emergency contact. I can review your 1-pager when you drop it here.

hr-bot: Reminder: Ticket #LR-2024-877 created. Please attach required documentation within 30 days to avoid top-up delays.

danielle.reed: Thanks everyone  I submitted Workday and left the draft 1-pager in Google Drive. Will ping when it's ready for review.

sam.hr: Sounds good  we'll confirm payroll once docs are attached. Reach out if you'd like a short benefits walkthrough session.
